paragraphs: Rav Hillel, Rav Ashi’s colleague: Yevamot 19a, 21,end of side b. He said to Rav Ashi, “I myself saw the list of secondary forbidden relatives attributed to Mar, Rabbana’s son.” He also addresses Rav Ashi there, 26a. He said to Rav Ashi, “When we were in Rav Kahana’s house”: Shabbat 109a; Bava Batra 98a; Chullin 53a.
